details: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts, particularly involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz, along with the Russia-Ukraine war, continue to influence global markets. These tensions lead to elevated energy and fertilizer prices, contributing to inflation risks. Investors are showing a reduced appetite for risk, often shifting towards "safe-haven" assets like gold and bonds, while riskier assets, including cryptocurrencies, may face downward pressure. While historical data suggests markets often recover from initial geopolitical shocks, the persistence of supply disruptions remains a key concern.
title: Geopolitical Conflicts Fuel Inflation Concerns and Market Caution
